frozen: 2026-11-01, before any result of this search; after the e66 screens (output/warm_current_20261031: the sea's swing mends, the land's swing falls with it), the e67 screens (output/continental_sea_20261031: Korea's seas right, the Baltic and North Sea too cold), the e64 shelf screens, and the r41 adoption (reports/R41_20261101.md: deserts and monsoon plateaus slightly warmer-wrong).
why: Two failures share one cause. The model's maritime land follows its sea too closely, so a sea that swings twice too far (British seas 4-17 C against 8-15) gave the land the right swing; mending the sea (e66) exposes the land. The land's own coupling (land_radiative_days, land_tau_days, land_amplitude) was fitted with the wrong seas, so it is searched together with the sea terms (e66, e67, e64). r41's wet-ground sunshine term (e69) also warms dry ground (wet share below wet_sun_ref 0.5), the likely cause of its slightly warmer deserts; wet_sun_ref joins the search so dry ground need not warm.
extra_reference_note: output/maritime_refit_20261101/r41_sealed_a is a plain r41 run of the first retired sealed set (scripts/benchmark_local.py with calibration/sealed_20261031/regions.json), made before the search; both sets are development data.
score: scripts/gate_calibrate.py: S as scripts/gate_local.py over dev31 against the r41 run, plus 2 x every policy group's worsening, 2 x each retired sealed set's worsening, and 2 x any T or P worsening beyond 1 %
validation: OUT=output/maritime_refit_20261101/refit REF_NAME=r41 REF_FIT=calibration/local_accuracy_20261023/r41_params.json BEST=calibration/maritime_refit_20261101/search/best_params.json SEALED_SPEC=calibration/sealed_20261101c/regions.json bash scripts/validate_monsoon_refit.sh: fresh paired dev31 runs under policy v2, the paired 28 km check, then sealed set c (declared 2026-11-01, never run) once if both pass; adoption also requires sealed set c not to get worse. If adopted it becomes r42 and the Earth-fit atlas is rebuilt with it. Failing any step means nothing is adopted; every result is reported.
